name: Scoped nullifier (reuse detection)

request.need: PR-UNQ: one presentation per (context, scope, purpose, epoch) — not 'one unique human'

statement: A verifier learns a deterministic nullifier for this context so a second presentation in the same context is detectable, while presentations in other contexts stay unlinkable.
witness: holder secret (the same one behind the membership leaf)

relation.clause: nullifier = H(secret, root, scope, purpose, epoch) computed in-circuit from the same secret as the membership leaf

doesNotEstablish: one enrolment per issuer or ecosystem (second point of the trade curve — governance, not cryptography)

adversary.claim: linkable within a context by design (declared, governed)

options.construction: Poseidon nullifier in the membership circuit (lab)

options.cost: one PRF evaluation in the commit-and-prove SNARK

history.evidence: zkp-tf #18 (talltree 08-26 / Scott 08-27): seed set for the board
same circuit as 001; scoped preimage tested 9/9 in runtime 01

formal.system: Lean 4.33.1, core library only (no Mathlib); axiom footprint within propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound — no sorry, no added axiom
formal.location: formal/Formal/Gadgets/P002Nullifier.lean in the evidence repository (uncommitted at this revision)
formal.reproduce: sh formal/scripts/check-axioms.sh — builds, prints each theorem's axiom footprint, fails on sorry or a non-standard axiom
formal.statement: Formal.Gadgets.NullifierRel — some secret behind this leaf gives this nullifier in this context

theorems.name: one_leaf_one_nullifier
theorems.proves: one leaf has one nullifier per context

theorems.name: reuse_refused
theorems.proves: nullifier-reused: once a leaf's nullifier is spent in a context, a second presentation of that leaf there is refused

theorems.name: unbound_nullifier_unsound
theorems.proves: the same-secret clause is necessary: a nullifier taken from any secret lets one leaf yield two nullifiers in one context

theorems.name: cross_context_not_detected
theorems.proves: does-not-establish 3: one secret gives different nullifiers in different contexts — no cross-context detection

theorems.name: one_person_two_nullifiers
theorems.proves: does-not-establish 1: one person enrolled twice gives two accepted nullifiers in one context

hypotheses.name: H-leaf
hypotheses.carries: the leaf commitment binds its secret (modelled as injective) — carries the same-secret clause

hypotheses.name: spent set
hypotheses.carries: the verifier keeps the context's spent nullifiers (Formal.Gadgets.Spent)

formal.scope: reuse detection over abstract hashes; unlinkability across contexts is a computational claim outside this model; does-not-establish 2 is governance

revisions.note: formal model built (Lean, gadget library): the clause as a definition, its soundness, the counter-deployments that show which hypotheses are necessary, and the negative space classified; no state change
